Proposition
[Interior regularity of Euclidean convex functions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0436 1. apph:H.5\group Euclidean convexity Every finite-valued convex function on a locally convex $C\subset \R ^n$ is locally Lipschitz, and hence differentiable almost everywhere, on $\operatorname {int}(C)$.
